title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie Towel Stand 49-Inch, 4 Pivoting Swing Arms, Solid Brass - | Matte Black | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom towel storage with an assorted free standing accessorie towel stand built from solid brass and designed with 4 pivoting swing arms to help maximize space without wall mounting in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stable base: heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
  • Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching

Specs
Material: Brass
Mounting type: Freestanding
Overall size: 49-Inch H x 12-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
Weight: 13.6 lb
Assembly required: Yes
Included: Towel stand
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Coordinates well with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.
